name: apollobank
description: Run the apollobank server and client together.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider TSC_COMPILE_ON_ERROR=true ESLINT_NO_DEV_ERRORS=true npm --prefix client start"
